contractText: This Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement (the 'Agreement') is entered into as of January 1, 2026, by and between Acme Innovations, Inc. ('Disclosing Party') and Beta Partners LLC ('Receiving Party'). Purpose: evaluation of a potential commercial relationship. Confidential Information: all non-public business, technical and financial information disclosed in writing and marked confidential, or disclosed orally and identified as confidential at disclosure. Obligations: Receiving Party shall hold Confidential Information in strict confidence, use it solely for the Purpose, and limit access to employees with a need to know who are bound by confidentiality obligations at least as protective as this Agreement. Term: confidentiality obligations survive for five (5) years from disclosure. Return: upon written request, Receiving Party shall return or destroy all Confidential Information and certify destruction in writing. No license or ownership right is granted except as necessary to evaluate the Purpose. Indemnification: Receiving Party shall indemnify Disclosing Party against all losses arising from any unauthorized use or disclosure of Confidential Information by Receiving Party. Liability: Disclosing Party's aggregate liability under this Agreement shall not exceed the total fees paid by Disclosing Party in the twelve months preceding the claim. General: this Agreement may not be amended except in writing signed by both parties; it is governed by the laws of the State of Delaware; any dispute shall be resolved by binding arbitration in Wilmington, Delaware.
